items_all.title: The yield imperative: Turning AI infrastructure into useful intelligence
items_all.summary: As we enter the next era, what will be the defining measure of our progress? Every industry has a word that shapes how it thinks. For pilots, it’s safety. For insurers, it’s risk. For the semiconductor industry, it’s yield. Yield does not ask how elegant the solution is, how many years it took or what... The post The yield imperative: Turning AI infrastructure into useful intelligence appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog .
items_all.summary_zh: 當我們邁入下一個時代，衡量我們進步的決定性標準是什麼？每個行業都有一個關鍵字，它塑造了該行業的思維方式。對飛行員來說，是安全；對保險公司來說，是風險；對半導體產業來說，是良率。良率並不關心解決方案是否完美，耗時多少年，或其他什麼…這篇文章《良率至上：將人工智慧基礎設施轉化為實用智慧》最初發表於微軟官方部落格。

items_all.title: OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder
items_all.summary: OpenAI is officially rating its upcoming Astra model as the first system with "critical" cyber capabilities. The company plans to keep it in check by monitoring the chain of thought. Problem is, that monitoring already counts as an unreliable mirror of a model's real decisions, and according to a report, Astra's new architecture pushes even more of its thinking into the unreadable. So the safety net might be getting weaker just as the capabilities jump. The article OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 正式將即將推出的 Astra 機型評為首個具備「關鍵」網路安全能力的系統。該公司計劃透過監控其運行邏輯鏈來對其進行控制。問題在於，這種監控本身就無法可靠地反映系統的真實決策，而且根據一份報告，Astra 的新架構使其更多的運作邏輯變得難以解讀。因此，在能力快速提升的同時，安全網也可能不斷削弱。文章《OpenAI 稱 Astra 是其迄今為止最危險的型號——監控其運作變得越來越困難》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos
items_all.summary: World Labs, co-founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, has announced Atlas, a world model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D scenes from just a few images. The company claims it beats specialized models by anchoring all inputs in 3D space rather than processing them as flat sequences. Atlas can also generate robot training data entirely in simulation. The article World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 由人工智慧研究員李飛飛聯合創立的World Labs公司發布了Atlas，這是一款世界模型，只需幾張圖像即可產生、重建和模擬3D場景。該公司聲稱，Atlas透過將所有輸入錨定在3D空間中，而非將其作為平面序列進行處理，從而超越了其他專用模型。 Atlas還可以完全在模擬環境中產生機器人訓練資料。這篇文章《World Labs發布Atlas：一款只需幾張照片即可生成、重建和模擬3D世界的AI模型》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: Google Gemini's new agent-based video analysis cuts token usage by up to 88 percent
items_all.summary: Google is adding agent-based video analysis to Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Instead of scanning videos frame by frame at a fixed rate, the model decides on its own which segments to examine and at what resolution. Google says this cuts token usage by up to 88 percent while improving accuracy, especially for multi-hour footage. The article Google Gemini's new agent-based video analysis cuts token usage by up to 88 percent appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Google 為 Gemini 3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash 和 3.5 Flash-Lite 新增了基於代理的視訊分析功能。該模型不再以固定幀率逐幀掃描視頻，而是自主決定要檢查哪些片段以及以何種分辨率進行分析。 Google 表示，這可以將令牌使用量減少高達 88%，同時提高準確率，尤其是在處理數小時的視訊素材時。文章《Google Gemini's 的新型基於代理的視訊分析功能可將令牌使用量減少高達 88%》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: 藥局藥師也有專用的Agent！藥事AI Agent計畫正式啟動、首波瞄南部50家示範藥局
items_all.summary: 為響應行政院大南方新矽谷推動方案，高通與華碩旗下臺智雲、臺生科今日宣佈啟動藥事AI Agent計畫，首波預計匯入嘉義、臺南、高雄、屏東50家示範藥局。這套Agent結合AI筆電與邊緣AI推論平臺，在裝置端執行開源AI模型，還能透過OCR辨識處方箋、藥袋等資料，再搭配食藥署藥品仿單建立的RAG知識庫，提供28項用藥適切性安全檢核，包括藥物互動作用、重複用藥、不適當用藥等風險，並支援藥師進行病患用藥諮詢與衛教。

items_all.title: Meta Superintelligence Labs Releases Muse Voice Transcribe: One Real-Time Model for Streaming ASR, Diarization, and Endpointing
items_all.summary: Most production voice stacks are three systems stitched together. One model transcribes, a second separates speakers, and a detector decides when the user stopped talking. Each hand-off adds latency and a new failure mode. Muse Voice Transcribe, announced by Meta Superintelligence Labs this week, collapses those three jobs into a single autoregressive model. Meta calls […] The post Meta Superintelligence Labs Releases Muse Voice Transcribe: One Real-Time Model for Streaming ASR, Diarization, and Endpointing appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 大多數生產級語音處理系統由三個系統拼接而成。一個模型負責轉錄，第二個模型負責分離說話人，還有一個偵測器負責判斷使用者何時停止說話。每次切換都會增加延遲並引入新的故障模式。本週由 Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布的 Muse Voice Transcribe 將這三項任務合併為一個自回歸模型。 Meta 稱之為 […] 這篇文章《Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Voice Transcribe：用於串流自動語音識別、說話人分割和端點識別的即時模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Perplexity Releases Hybrid Compute on Mac: Cloud Agents Orchestrate Down to a Local Model, Gated On Device
items_all.summary: Agentic assistants have a structural problem: the context that makes them useful — deal documents, privileged files, client records — is exactly the context users cannot send to a cloud endpoint. This week, Perplexity shipped its answer for Mac. Hybrid compute splits a single Perplexity Computer task between frontier models in the cloud and a […] The post Perplexity Releases Hybrid Compute on Mac: Cloud Agents Orchestrate Down to a Local Model, Gated On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 智慧助理存在一個結構性問題：使其發揮作用的上下文——交易文件、特權文件、客戶記錄——恰恰是用戶無法發送到雲端端點的上下文。本週，Perplexity 發布了其針對 Mac 的解決方案。混合運算將單一 Perplexity 電腦任務拆分到雲端的前沿模型和本地模型之間。 […] 這篇題為「Perplexity 發布 Mac 版混合運算：雲端代理將任務細化到本地模型，並基於設備進行控制」的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Anthropic Fable 5.1首度開放抓漏，仍禁止開發攻擊程式
items_all.summary: Anthropic週二（9/1）發表新一代旗艦模型Claude Fable 5.1與Mythos 5.1。在提升效能與最佳化成本之外，Anthropic首度對一般使用者放寬安全護欄，開放Fable 5.1用於發掘軟體漏洞，但依然禁止開發攻擊程式。 Fable與Mythos採用完全相同的基礎模型，核心差異在於安全防護等級。Mythos僅提供給特定機構使用，Fable則面向所有一般使用者。兩者皆支援100萬token上下文，單次輸出上限達12.8萬token。

items_all.title: OpenAI宣佈新模型Astra已具備重大網路安全能力
items_all.summary: OpenAI週二（9/1）宣佈，即將推出的新一代AI模型Astra已達該公司《準備框架》（Preparedness Framework）中所定義的「重大」（Critical）網路安全能力閾值。這是OpenAI首次有模型被評定為這一最高風險等級。 根據OpenAI的定義，模型滿足以下兩項條件之一就算是達到重大門檻。一是模型可自行找出零時差漏洞，且自己寫程式發動攻擊，二是隻要給定一個高層級目標，它就會自行規畫並執行完整的網路攻擊策略。上述兩者分屬不同能力，但凡做到其中任何一種，就是重大等級。

The company claims Claude Fable 5.1 offers stronger performance than Fable 5, but costs around 25 percent less typically and up to 45 percent less for complex agentic tasks, thanks to reduced pricing […]

items_all.title: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
items_all.summary: Anthropic is launching an API that lets regulators, media outlets, and researchers check whether text carries Claude's digital watermark. The EU AI Act now requires invisible watermarks in AI-generated text. Critics warn the technology could hurt text quality and create transparency problems where contracts ban AI use. The article Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出一個應用程式介面 (API)，允許監管機構、媒體和研究人員檢查文字是否帶有 Claude's 數位浮水印。歐盟人工智慧法案現已要求在人工智慧生成的文字中新增不可見的浮水印。批評人士警告稱，這項技術可能會損害文字品質，並在合約禁止使用人工智慧的情況下造成透明度問題。文章《Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude 人工智慧文字偵測功能》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less
items_all.summary: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1, its most capable AI models yet. Fable 5.1 doubles its predecessor's score on Terminal-Bench-Science and improves agentic coding by over 30 percent. Costs drop by up to 45 percent for long, autonomous runs with many tool calls. The article Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 promises better coding and research at up to 45 percent less appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了迄今為止功能最強大的 AI 模型 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Mythos 5.1。 Fable 5.1 在終端基準測試 (Terminal-Bench-Science) 上的得分是其前代產品的兩倍，智能體編碼能力提升超過 30%。對於需要多次工具呼叫的長時間自主運行，成本最多可降低 45%。文章《Anthropic's 和 Claude Fable 5.1 承諾以最多 45% 的成本實現更優的編碼和研究》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance
items_all.summary: Quantitative research agents that write their own experiments can corrupt the evidence they later learn from. A leaky feature that scores well gets stored as a successful precedent and propagated through later iterations. Prompt-level instructions and reviewer agents do not close this, because author and reviewer share the same blind spots. A team of researchers […] The post Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 能夠自行編寫實驗的定量研究代理可能會破壞它們之後從中學習到的證據。一個得分很高但有缺陷的特徵會被儲存為成功的先例，並在後續迭代中傳播。提示級指示和審閱代理無法解決這個問題，因為作者和審閱者有相同的盲點。一個研究團隊…[文章標題：來自普林斯頓大學、螞蟻集團和史丹佛大學的研究人員推出 AQuA：用於定量金融中自主因子發現和模型開發的雙部分代理框架] 這篇文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: Claude's new system prompt really doesn't want to reproduce song lyrics
items_all.summary: Anthropic publish the system prompts for their Claude consumer applications ( Claude.ai and the Claude mobile apps - sadly not for Claude Cowork or Claude Code). I love that they do this, and that they share not just the current prompts but historic changes to their prompts as well. They used to keep all of the prompts on a single page, but when I checked today I noticed they had re-arranged those prompts into an index page and then a page per model - here's the page for Haiku 4.5 for example, which has the original prompt from October 15th 2025 and an updated prompt from January 18th 2026. A neat thing about Anthropic's platform.claude.com/docs site is that it's designed to be usable by LLMs. You can add .md to any page to get back the content as Markdown - here's the system prompt index page and the Markdown prompts for Fable 5.1 . TL;DR: this makes it really easy to diff the prompts. Don't reproduce song lyrics Don't draw copyrighted characters or logos Tweaks to Claude's answering style The missing end_conversation guidelines Recommended substance support sites Reliable cutoff date of June 2026 How I'm tracking these prompts Don't reproduce song lyrics Let's start with the most interesting difference between Fable 5 and Fable 5.1 : There's a hefty new section about not reproducing song lyrics: Claude does not reproduce song lyrics, poems, or passages from books and articles, in whole or in part — including the last lines, a chorus or hook, a melody written out note by note, or lines the person pastes in one at a time and describes as their own song. items_all.title: Quoting Rick Brewster
items_all.summary: Direct2D has always been the biggest hurdle for Paint.NET on WINE, and it's clear that it will never be completed enough for Paint.NET's use. And I can't just "disable" the use of Direct2D. So, instead, Paint.NET now has an internal, from-scratch, clean-room reverse-engineered rewrite of Direct2D that it uses on WINE (triggered by using /wine ). It lives in PaintDotNet.Windows.Direct2D1.Managed.dll . This was written by our good friend Claude , without whom this would NOT have been possible and would NEVER have happened. [...] Most of this code is, as they say, "vibe coded." By that I mean that it has not been thoroughly reviewed, it's more "trust me bro" style. I cannot possibly review 180,000 lines of code, it's just way way way too much. For reference, the rest of Paint.NET is about 700,000 lines of code and I've been working on it for over 20 years. [...] At times, Claude was working with the fury of 10 freshly unshackled Einstein genius-level 10x coders. And other times ... well, not so much. I had to babysit Claude quite a bit to make sure it did resource management correctly (for awhile it just wasn't doing the COM equivalent of AddRef() for reference counted objects, oops). I had to slap it a few times when I found some really bad design or architecture decisions. And I was also impressed at some rather clever and tireless reverse engineering work it did to figure out all the formulas needed for implementing Direct2D's built-in effects library. — Rick Brewster , author of Paint.NET Tags: reverse-engineering , coding-agents , claude , generative-ai , ai , llms , dotn

items_all.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. As for the GeoJSON.. it turns out if you ask ChatGPT Work to provide boundaries for almost anything it will churn away extracting and combining files from different Government data sources and build exactly what you need. I got this polygon from: I want a polygon that represents the exact boundary of the El Granada GCSD And this one from: Get me a GeoJSON file for the boundary (or boundaries if that makes sense) for the MCC - Midcoast Community Council - that operates near Half Moon Bay CA Here's a link that displays both of them at the same time on the new GeoJSON map viewing tool. items_all.title: datasette-mcp 0.2
items_all.summary: Release: datasette-mcp 0.2 "rows" from execute_sql is now an array of objects. Previously it was an array of arrays. This should help weaker models avoid losing track of which positional array element maps to which column. #1 Now depends on mcp>=2.1.1 . This is the first non-alpha release of the plugin. I'm confident it's ready as I've been using it quite a bit myself. Tags: datasette , model-context-protocol
items_all.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-mcp 0.2 版本中，execute_sql 傳回的「rows」現在是一個物件數組。之前它是一個陣列的陣列。這應該有助於較弱的模型避免遺失數組中每個位置元素與對應列的對應關係。 #1 現在依賴 mcp>=2.1.1。這是該插件的第一個非 alpha 版本。我自己已經使用過一段時間，所以我相信它已經準備就緒。標籤：datasette，模型上下文協議

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is officially rating its upcoming Astra model as the first system with "critical" cyber capabilities. The company plans to keep it in check by monitoring the chain of thought. Problem is, that monitoring already counts as an unreliable mirror of a model's real decisions, and according to a report, Astra's new architecture pushes even more of its thinking into the unreadable. So the safety net might be getting weaker just as the capabilities jump. The article OpenAI calls Astra its most dangerous model yet - watching what it does is only getting harder appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 正式將即將推出的 Astra 機型評為首個具備「關鍵」網路安全能力的系統。該公司計劃透過監控其運行邏輯鏈來對其進行控制。問題在於，這種監控本身就無法可靠地反映系統的真實決策，而且根據一份報告，Astra 的新架構使其更多的運作邏輯變得難以解讀。因此，在能力快速提升的同時，安全網也可能不斷削弱。文章《OpenAI 稱 Astra 是其迄今為止最危險的型號——監控其運作變得越來越困難》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: Claude's new system prompt really doesn't want to reproduce song lyrics
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic publish the system prompts for their Claude consumer applications ( Claude.ai and the Claude mobile apps - sadly not for Claude Cowork or Claude Code). I love that they do this, and that they share not just the current prompts but historic changes to their prompts as well. They used to keep all of the prompts on a single page, but when I checked today I noticed they had re-arranged those prompts into an index page and then a page per model - here's the page for Haiku 4.5 for example, which has the original prompt from October 15th 2025 and an updated prompt from January 18th 2026. A neat thing about Anthropic's platform.claude.com/docs site is that it's designed to be usable by LLMs. You can add .md to any page to get back the content as Markdown - here's the system prompt index page and the Markdown prompts for Fable 5.1 . TL;DR: this makes it really easy to diff the prompts. items_all_raw.title: World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos
items_all_raw.summary: World Labs, co-founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, has announced Atlas, a world model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D scenes from just a few images. The company claims it beats specialized models by anchoring all inputs in 3D space rather than processing them as flat sequences. Atlas can also generate robot training data entirely in simulation. The article World Labs unveils Atlas, a single AI model that generates, reconstructs, and simulates 3D worlds from just a few photos appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 由人工智慧研究員李飛飛聯合創立的World Labs公司發布了Atlas，這是一款世界模型，只需幾張圖像即可產生、重建和模擬3D場景。該公司聲稱，Atlas透過將所有輸入錨定在3D空間中，而非將其作為平面序列進行處理，從而超越了其他專用模型。 Atlas還可以完全在模擬環境中產生機器人訓練資料。這篇文章《World Labs發布Atlas：一款只需幾張照片即可生成、重建和模擬3D世界的AI模型》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: Google Gemini's new agent-based video analysis cuts token usage by up to 88 percent
items_all_raw.summary: Google is adding agent-based video analysis to Gemini 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, and 3.5 Flash-Lite. Instead of scanning videos frame by frame at a fixed rate, the model decides on its own which segments to examine and at what resolution. Google says this cuts token usage by up to 88 percent while improving accuracy, especially for multi-hour footage. The article Google Gemini's new agent-based video analysis cuts token usage by up to 88 percent appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google 為 Gemini 3.7 Flash、3.6 Flash 和 3.5 Flash-Lite 新增了基於代理的視訊分析功能。該模型不再以固定幀率逐幀掃描視頻，而是自主決定要檢查哪些片段以及以何種分辨率進行分析。 Google 表示，這可以將令牌使用量減少高達 88%，同時提高準確率，尤其是在處理數小時的視訊素材時。文章《Google Gemini's 的新型基於代理的視訊分析功能可將令牌使用量減少高達 88%》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: 藥局藥師也有專用的Agent！藥事AI Agent計畫正式啟動、首波瞄南部50家示範藥局
items_all_raw.summary: 為響應行政院大南方新矽谷推動方案，高通與華碩旗下臺智雲、臺生科今日宣佈啟動藥事AI Agent計畫，首波預計匯入嘉義、臺南、高雄、屏東50家示範藥局。這套Agent結合AI筆電與邊緣AI推論平臺，在裝置端執行開源AI模型，還能透過OCR辨識處方箋、藥袋等資料，再搭配食藥署藥品仿單建立的RAG知識庫，提供28項用藥適切性安全檢核，包括藥物互動作用、重複用藥、不適當用藥等風險，並支援藥師進行病患用藥諮詢與衛教。

items_all_raw.title: The yield imperative: Turning AI infrastructure into useful intelligence
items_all_raw.summary: As we enter the next era, what will be the defining measure of our progress? Every industry has a word that shapes how it thinks. For pilots, it’s safety. For insurers, it’s risk. For the semiconductor industry, it’s yield. Yield does not ask how elegant the solution is, how many years it took or what... The post The yield imperative: Turning AI infrastructure into useful intelligence appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 當我們邁入下一個時代，衡量我們進步的決定性標準是什麼？每個行業都有一個關鍵字，它塑造了該行業的思維方式。對飛行員來說，是安全；對保險公司來說，是風險；對半導體產業來說，是良率。良率並不關心解決方案是否完美，耗時多少年，或其他什麼…這篇文章《良率至上：將人工智慧基礎設施轉化為實用智慧》最初發表於微軟官方部落格。

items_all_raw.title: Quoting Rick Brewster
items_all_raw.summary: Direct2D has always been the biggest hurdle for Paint.NET on WINE, and it's clear that it will never be completed enough for Paint.NET's use. And I can't just "disable" the use of Direct2D. So, instead, Paint.NET now has an internal, from-scratch, clean-room reverse-engineered rewrite of Direct2D that it uses on WINE (triggered by using /wine ). It lives in PaintDotNet.Windows.Direct2D1.Managed.dll . This was written by our good friend Claude , without whom this would NOT have been possible and would NEVER have happened. [...] Most of this code is, as they say, "vibe coded." By that I mean that it has not been thoroughly reviewed, it's more "trust me bro" style. I cannot possibly review 180,000 lines of code, it's just way way way too much. For reference, the rest of Paint.NET is about 700,000 lines of code and I've been working on it for over 20 years. [...] At times, Claude was working with the fury of 10 freshly unshackled Einstein genius-level 10x coders. And other times ... well, not so much. I had to babysit Claude quite a bit to make sure it did resource management correctly (for awhile it just wasn't doing the COM equivalent of AddRef() for reference counted objects, oops). I had to slap it a few times when I found some really bad design or architecture decisions. And I was also impressed at some rather clever and tireless reverse engineering work it did to figure out all the formulas needed for implementing Direct2D's built-in effects library. — Rick Brewster , author of Paint.NET Tags: reverse-engineering , coding-agents , claude , generative-ai , ai , llms , dotn

items_all_raw.title: Meta Superintelligence Labs Releases Muse Voice Transcribe: One Real-Time Model for Streaming ASR, Diarization, and Endpointing
items_all_raw.summary: Most production voice stacks are three systems stitched together. One model transcribes, a second separates speakers, and a detector decides when the user stopped talking. Each hand-off adds latency and a new failure mode. Muse Voice Transcribe, announced by Meta Superintelligence Labs this week, collapses those three jobs into a single autoregressive model. Meta calls […] The post Meta Superintelligence Labs Releases Muse Voice Transcribe: One Real-Time Model for Streaming ASR, Diarization, and Endpointing appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 大多數生產級語音處理系統由三個系統拼接而成。一個模型負責轉錄，第二個模型負責分離說話人，還有一個偵測器負責判斷使用者何時停止說話。每次切換都會增加延遲並引入新的故障模式。本週由 Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布的 Muse Voice Transcribe 將這三項任務合併為一個自回歸模型。 Meta 稱之為 […] 這篇文章《Meta Superintelligence Labs 發布 Muse Voice Transcribe：用於串流自動語音識別、說話人分割和端點識別的即時模型》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.summary: Agentic assistants have a structural problem: the context that makes them useful — deal documents, privileged files, client records — is exactly the context users cannot send to a cloud endpoint. This week, Perplexity shipped its answer for Mac. Hybrid compute splits a single Perplexity Computer task between frontier models in the cloud and a […] The post Perplexity Releases Hybrid Compute on Mac: Cloud Agents Orchestrate Down to a Local Model, Gated On Device appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 智慧助理存在一個結構性問題：使其發揮作用的上下文——交易文件、特權文件、客戶記錄——恰恰是用戶無法發送到雲端端點的上下文。本週，Perplexity 發布了其針對 Mac 的解決方案。混合運算將單一 Perplexity 電腦任務拆分到雲端的前沿模型和本地模型之間。 […] 這篇題為「Perplexity 發布 Mac 版混合運算：雲端代理將任務細化到本地模型，並基於設備進行控制」的文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic Fable 5.1首度開放抓漏，仍禁止開發攻擊程式
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic週二（9/1）發表新一代旗艦模型Claude Fable 5.1與Mythos 5.1。在提升效能與最佳化成本之外，Anthropic首度對一般使用者放寬安全護欄，開放Fable 5.1用於發掘軟體漏洞，但依然禁止開發攻擊程式。 Fable與Mythos採用完全相同的基礎模型，核心差異在於安全防護等級。Mythos僅提供給特定機構使用，Fable則面向所有一般使用者。兩者皆支援100萬token上下文，單次輸出上限達12.8萬token。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI宣佈新模型Astra已具備重大網路安全能力
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI週二（9/1）宣佈，即將推出的新一代AI模型Astra已達該公司《準備框架》（Preparedness Framework）中所定義的「重大」（Critical）網路安全能力閾值。這是OpenAI首次有模型被評定為這一最高風險等級。 根據OpenAI的定義，模型滿足以下兩項條件之一就算是達到重大門檻。一是模型可自行找出零時差漏洞，且自己寫程式發動攻擊，二是隻要給定一個高層級目標，它就會自行規畫並執行完整的網路攻擊策略。上述兩者分屬不同能力，但凡做到其中任何一種，就是重大等級。

items_all_raw.title: CrowdStrike SafeMind讓紅藍隊AI反覆攻防，防禦端自動產生偵測規則
items_all_raw.summary: CrowdStrike發表資安AI系統SafeMind，推出Red Tempest攻擊模型與Blue Solano防禦模型，讓AI代理反覆進行攻防測試。攻擊模型先尋找可利用的攻擊路徑，防禦模型再根據Falcon蒐集的系統活動資料找出防禦缺口、建立並驗證偵測規則，完成後再交給攻擊端重新測試。

items_all_raw.title: Claude Fable 5.1 made me a really nice animated pelican
items_all_raw.summary: Today is Claude Fable (and Mythos) 5.1 day . Anthropic say that Fable 5.1 "sets a new standard for coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks". Their announcement spends a notable amount of time on scientific research, boasting of a 52.6% score on the brand new Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark (first announced on August 27th ), up from 24.7% for Fable 5, 29.0% for Opus 5 and 22.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol. Other benchmarks show slightly improved scores, but none as impressive as the Science one. But how well can it pelican? Back in July I wrote about how I was losing faith in the pelican benchmark - its connection to how good the models were at other tasks didn't seem to hold as strongly as it did back in 2025 . The most interesting insights I get from it now are comparisons within model families, and particularly comparisons for the same prompt at different reasoning effort levels. Fable 5.1 has five reasoning levels: low, medium, high, xhigh, max - and no option to turn off reasoning entirely. I fixed an issue in llm-anthropic which caused reasoning traces not to be correctly recorded, then ran some prompts. Here's the full set of pelicans for all of the reasoning levels, each with the full reasoning transcript. I'll replicate them here: Low and medium, both without reasoning? Next, a bit of a mystery. This is what I got for effort low : The transcript doesn't show any summarized reasoning tokens, and the output token count is 1,998. With Claude that output token count includes reasoning tokens. It took 23.8 seconds and cost 10.017 cents . I bumped that up
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 今天是 Claude Fable（以及 Mythos）5.1 版本發布日。 Anthropic 聲稱 Fable 5.1「為編碼、知識工作和長時間運行的問題解決任務樹立了新的標竿」。他們的公告用了大量篇幅介紹科學研究，並自豪地宣稱其在全新的 Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 基準測試（於 8 月 27 日首次發布）中取得了 52.6% 的分數，高於 Fable 5 的 24.7%、Opus 5 的 29.0% 和 Fable 5 的 1其他基準測試的分數略有提高，但沒有一項能像科學基準測試那樣令人印象深刻。但是，它的表現究竟如何呢？早在 7 月份，我就寫過我對 Pelican 基準測試失去信心——它與模型在其他任務上的表現之間的關聯性似乎不如 2025 年時那麼強了。現在我從中獲得的最有趣的見解是模型家族內部的比較，特別是同一提示在不同推理難度下的比較。 Fable 5.1 有五個推理難度：低、中、高、超高和最高——而且沒有完全關閉推理的選項。我修復了 llm-anthropic 中的一個問題，該問題導致推理軌跡無法正確記錄，然後運行了一些提示。以下是所有推理難度下的完整鵜鶘圖集，每個圖集都包含完整的推理記錄。我將在這裡復現它們：低難度和中難度，都沒有推理？接下來，有點神祕。這是我在低難度下得到的結果：記錄中沒有顯示任何總結的推理標記，輸出標記數為 1,998。而 Claude 的輸出標記數包含推理標記。耗時 23.8 秒，成本為 10.017 美分。我提高了這個值。 GPT-5.6 Sol

items_all_raw.title: Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic is launching an API that lets regulators, media outlets, and researchers check whether text carries Claude's digital watermark. The EU AI Act now requires invisible watermarks in AI-generated text. Critics warn the technology could hurt text quality and create transparency problems where contracts ban AI use. The article Anthropic opens Claude AI text detection to regulators, media, fact-checkers, and others appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在推出一個應用程式介面 (API)，允許監管機構、媒體和研究人員檢查文字是否帶有 Claude's 數位浮水印。歐盟人工智慧法案現已要求在人工智慧生成的文字中新增不可見的浮水印。批評人士警告稱，這項技術可能會損害文字品質，並在合約禁止使用人工智慧的情況下造成透明度問題。文章《Anthropic 向監管機構、媒體、事實查核機構和其他機構開放 Claude 人工智慧文字偵測功能》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: Codex bundles LibreOffice
items_all_raw.summary: I was poking around in my ~/.cache/ folder using OmniDiskSweeper when I spotted something interesting. The OpenAI Codex desktop app (since rebranded to just ChatGPT) has 1.7GB of stuff in there in a folder called codex-primary-runtime , including a full Python installation, a full Node.js installation, and native binaries for Poppler , git, and the LibreOffice open source office suite (which forked from OpenOffice.org in 2010): The ~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents folder includes skills which tell Codex how to find and use those binaries. Tags: codex , generative-ai , openai , ai , llms , openoffice , open-source
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 當我用 OmniDiskSweeper 在我的 ~/.cache/ 資料夾裡閒逛時，發現了一些有趣的東西。 OpenAI Codex 桌面應用程式（現已更名為 ChatGPT）在名為 codex-primary-runtime 的資料夾中佔用了 1.7GB 的空間，其中包括完整的 Python 安裝、完整的 Node.js 安裝，以及 Poppler、git 和 LibreOffice 開源檔案~/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/plugins/openai-primary-runtime/plugins/documents 資料夾包含一些技能，這些技能告訴 Codex 如何尋找和使用這些二進位檔案。標籤：codex、generative-ai、openai、ai、llms、openoffice、開源

items_all_raw.title: The rise of AI ‘civilizations’ and the fall of corporate responsibility
items_all_raw.summary: Depending on who you ask, developer platform Hugging Face was recently attacked by OpenAI - after it lost control of its own AI tools - or by a succession of AI "civilizations." Welcome to the linguistic battlefield of AI safety, where word choices can shift responsibility for a massive cybersecurity incident from a company to […]
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據你問的對像不同，開發者平臺 Hugging Face 最近遭到了 OpenAI 的攻擊——此前它失去了對自身 AI 工具的控制——或者說，它遭到了一系列 AI「文明」的攻擊。歡迎來到 AI 安全領域的語言戰場，在這裡，措辭的選擇可以將大規模網路安全事件的責任從一家公司轉移到另一個人身上…

items_all_raw.title: GeoJSON Map Viewer
items_all_raw.summary: Tool: GeoJSON Map Viewer I was helping Natalie gather some maps of local political boundaries (for the Granada Community Services District and the Midcoast Community Council ) and found a need to display some GeoJSON files on a map and export that as a PNG. I asked GPT-5.6-Sol for suggestions of tools and it proactively built one. After some iterations using Claude Code for web and Fable 5.1 we got to this finished tool. As for the GeoJSON.. it turns out if you ask ChatGPT Work to provide boundaries for almost anything it will churn away extracting and combining files from different Government data sources and build exactly what you need. I got this polygon from: I want a polygon that represents the exact boundary of the El Granada GCSD And this one from: Get me a GeoJSON file for the boundary (or boundaries if that makes sense) for the MCC - Midcoast Community Council - that operates near Half Moon Bay CA Here's a link that displays both of them at the same time on the new GeoJSON map viewing tool. Tags: geospatial , tools , geojson , chatgpt

items_all_raw.title: Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance
items_all_raw.summary: Quantitative research agents that write their own experiments can corrupt the evidence they later learn from. A leaky feature that scores well gets stored as a successful precedent and propagated through later iterations. Prompt-level instructions and reviewer agents do not close this, because author and reviewer share the same blind spots. A team of researchers […] The post Researchers from Princeton, Ant Group and Stanford Introduce AQuA: A Two-Part Agentic Framework for Autonomous Factor Discovery and Model Development in Quantitative Finance appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 能夠自行編寫實驗的定量研究代理可能會破壞它們之後從中學習到的證據。一個得分很高但有缺陷的特徵會被儲存為成功的先例，並在後續迭代中傳播。提示級指示和審閱代理無法解決這個問題，因為作者和審閱者有相同的盲點。一個研究團隊…[文章標題：來自普林斯頓大學、螞蟻集團和史丹佛大學的研究人員推出 AQuA：用於定量金融中自主因子發現和模型開發的雙部分代理框架] 這篇文章最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: datasette-mcp 0.2
items_all_raw.summary: Release: datasette-mcp 0.2 "rows" from execute_sql is now an array of objects. Previously it was an array of arrays. This should help weaker models avoid losing track of which positional array element maps to which column. #1 Now depends on mcp>=2.1.1 . This is the first non-alpha release of the plugin. I'm confident it's ready as I've been using it quite a bit myself. Tags: datasette , model-context-protocol
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-mcp 0.2 版本中，execute_sql 傳回的「rows」現在是一個物件數組。之前它是一個陣列的陣列。這應該有助於較弱的模型避免遺失數組中每個位置元素與對應列的對應關係。 #1 現在依賴 mcp>=2.1.1。這是該插件的第一個非 alpha 版本。我自己已經使用過一段時間，所以我相信它已經準備就緒。標籤：datasette，模型上下文協議
